Name: Battered VK Longsword
Description:
A one-handed sword with reduced performance due to damage.

Its reliability as a weapon is compromised. 

Strong attacks deliver a sharp thrust.

Midair strong attacks perform a downward cut.

A standard-issue sword used by revenant hunters. The blade, having survived many battles, is deeply scarred and unable to perform at its original potential.

Name: VK Longsword
Description:
A one-handed sword that requires Strength and Dexterity.

Its balanced performance makes it easy to wield. 

Strong attacks deliver a sharp thrust.

Midair strong attacks perform a downward cut.

A standard-issue sword used by revenant hunters. In the future, the blood that coats its blade will either be used to protect or to take. It all depends on the wielder.

Name: Ancient Hunter's Sword
Description:
A one-handed sword with minimal stat burden. 

Weak attacks can be chained repeatedly as long as stamina allows.

Strong attacks perform a diving slash, while charged strong attacks deliver two consecutive strikes after the dive.

Midair strong attacks perform a downward cut.

A sword once used by revenant hunters of a bygone era. Designed for ease of use, its excellent handling made it a trusted companion to many hunters on the battlefield.

Name: Cursed Masamune
Description:
A one-handed sword that requires Strength and Dexterity.

Strong attacks deliver a powerful downward slash after stepping forward.

Midair strong attacks perform a downward cut.

A sword imbued with a blood curse, based on a weapon crafted by a legendary revenant swordsmith. When wielded by a master of Far Eastern swordsmanship, its slash strikes with such precision it seems to drain every drop of the foe's blood.

Name: Ame-no-Habakiri Greatsword
Description:
A one-handed sword that requires Strength, Dexterity, and Mind.

Attacks are imbued with the blood element.

Strong attacks deliver a swift series of slashes. Charged strong attacks deliver a powerful downward slash after stepping forward.

Midair strong attacks perform a downward cut.

A special one-handed sword spoken of in Far Eastern mythology. Legend says this mighty blade once slew a monstrous serpent. Its blade, having drunk deeply of the creature's blood, emits an ominous glow.

Name: Carmilla's Thorn
Description:
A one-handed sword that primarily requires Dexterity.

Weak attacks can be chained repeatedly as long as stamina allows.

Strong attacks deliver a series of thrusts, while charged strong attacks perform a stepping thrust.

Midair strong attacks execute a falling thrust.

A sword once favored by a female revenant renowned on the battlefield. The graceful movements followed by a flurry of thrusting techniques are said to pierce through all obstacles, evidence of her unyielding conviction.

Name: Blade of Malice
Description:
A one-handed sword that primarily requires Dexterity and Willpower.

Inflicts buildup of the bind status ailment.

Weak attacks can be chained repeatedly as long as stamina allows.

Strong attacks deliver a series of thrusts, while charged strong attacks perform a lunging thrust.

Midair strong attacks execute a falling thrust.

A sword that harbors intense pathos. It will not rest until it binds the subject of its animosity for all time. The blade seethes with resentment at its prey having escaped.

Name: Executioner's Sword
Description:
A one-handed sword that primarily requires Dexterity and Mind.

Weak attacks can be chained repeatedly as long as stamina allows.

Strong attacks deliver a series of thrusts, while charged strong attacks perform a lunging thrust.

Midair strong attacks execute a falling thrust.

A sword that harbors intense pathos. Used to extinguish the sinful. Countless sentiments have come to dwell in the blade, as well as a noble sense of virtue and dedication to its purpose.

Name: Zealot's Ceremonial Sword
Description:
A one-handed sword that requires Strength, Dexterity, and Mind.

Its strong attack is an area-clearing sweep. Its charged strong attack consumes ichor to unleash an ice-element slash.

Midair strong attacks perform a downward cut.

Used in rituals by a revenant cult, this sword mimics the distinctive objects observed in the aftermath of the Resurgence phenomenon. Their reverence for the Resurgence drove them to forge ceremonial weapons inspired by its grotesque transformations.

Name: Blade of Tenacity
Description:
A one-handed sword that primarily requires Dexterity.

Strong attacks deliver a swift series of slashes. Charged strong attacks deliver a powerful downward slash after stepping forward.

Midair strong attacks execute a falling thrust.

This sword is a replica of the one used by Lyle. Though no formae are engraved, its unique balance makes each swing evoke visions of Lyle's unmatched swordsmanship.

Name: Blade of Tenacity: Thunderstrike
Description:
Lyle's one-handed sword that primarily requires Dexterity.

Attacks are imbued with the lightning element.

Strong attacks deliver a swift series of slashes. Charged strong attacks deliver a powerful downward slash after stepping forward.

Midair strong attacks execute a falling thrust.

A sword custom-made by Lyle for his own use. It is engraved with a forma passed down through the McLeish family that enables control over lightning. The unique balance of the blade ensures that the power of every sword strike is maximized, having been adjusted to reflect Lyle's precise control.

Name: Thorn of Devotion
Description:
Lou's one-handed sword that primarily requires Mind.

Weak attacks can be chained repeatedly as long as stamina allows.

Strong attacks deliver a series of thrusts, while charged strong attacks perform a stepping thrust.

Midair strong attacks execute a falling thrust.

A sword custom-made by Lou for her own use. When undertaking the mission to subjugate the heroes, Lou drew courage from the legendary feats of the warrior Carmilla, as recounted in history books, and recreated her weapon as faithfully as possible.

Name: Tainted Sword
Description:
A one-handed sword that requires Strength and Dexterity.

Strong attacks deliver a powerful downward slash after stepping forward.

Midair strong attacks perform a downward cut.

Used by Voda soldiers, the sword's shape has become grotesquely warped from prolonged overexposure to ichor induced by the user's frenzy.

Name: Darkborn Blade
Description:
A one-handed sword that requires Strength and Dexterity.

Inflicts buildup of the toxic venom status ailment.

Weak attacks can be chained repeatedly as long as stamina allows.

Strong attacks are a diving slash, while charged strong attacks deliver two consecutive strikes after the dive.

Midair strong attacks perform a downward cut.

A sword wielded by decayed revenants. The blade, wrapped in putrid flesh fragments, brings excruciating pain to those it strikes.

Name: Resurgence Flame Sword
Description:
A one-handed sword that requires Strength, Dexterity, and Willpower.

Weak attacks can be chained repeatedly as long as stamina allows.

Its strong attack is an area-clearing sweep. Its charged strong attack consumes ichor to unleash an ice-element slash.

Midair strong attacks perform a downward cut.

A sword born of revenants spawned within Luna Rapacis. No longer human in form or nature, these beings emerged as a twisted consequence of the Resurgence. The weapons they wield blaze with the warped flames of that transformation.

Name: Wandering Specter's Blade
Description:
A one-handed sword that requires Strength, Dexterity, and Willpower.

Inflicts buildup of the stone status ailment.

Strong attacks deliver a series of thrusts, while charged strong attacks perform a stepping thrust.

Midair strong attacks execute a falling thrust.

A floating sword wielded by wandering specters. Infused with the dark pathos surrounding the Undead Forest, its blade drastically weakens the life force of those it touches.

Name: Pipe of Thralldom
Description:
A one-handed sword that is rather unreliable as a weapon.

Strong attacks deliver a sharp thrust.

Midair strong attacks perform a downward cut.

It is simply an iron pipe with a certain degree of strength, making it unreliable as a weapon for ordinary people. However, it is also said that a master does not choose their weapon.

Name: Nameless Sword
Description:
A one-handed sword that requires Strength, Dexterity, and Fortitude.

Strong attacks are a diving slash, while charged strong attacks deliver two consecutive strikes after the dive.

Midair strong attacks perform a downward cut.

This sword drifted in from beyond the frontier. Its origin is unclear, but the discovery of many identical weapons suggests it was mass-produced—likely in response to a significant threat.

Name: Old Engraved Blade
Description:
A one-handed sword with low stat burden and high offensive power. 

Strong attacks are a diving slash, while charged strong attacks deliver two consecutive strikes after the dive.

Midair strong attacks perform a downward cut.

Crafted with a unique design philosophy, this one-handed sword is forged from materials with an extremely low burden, making it accessible to nearly any wielder. The faded engravings etched into its frame carry a quiet, sorrowful emotion.

Name: Broadsword
Description:
A one-handed sword that primarily requires Strength.

Weak attacks can be chained repeatedly as long as stamina allows.

Strong attacks are a diving slash, while charged strong attacks deliver two consecutive strikes after the dive.

Midair strong attacks perform a downward cut.

This sword drifted in from beyond the frontier. Its mass-produced design is apparent, but its hefty weight suggests it was built for wielders with exceptional physiques.

Name: Hanemukuro
Description:
A one-handed sword that requires Strength and Dexterity.

Strong attacks deliver a swift series of slashes. Charged strong attacks deliver a powerful downward slash after stepping forward.

Midair strong attacks perform a downward cut.

This sword drifted in from beyond the frontier, bearing the name "Mukuro." It is designed with a philosophy almost identical to that of a Japanese katana.

Name: Machete
Description:
A one-handed sword that primarily requires Strength.

Weak attacks can be chained repeatedly as long as stamina allows.

Strong attacks unleash a sharp thrust.

Midair strong attacks execute a falling thrust.

This sword drifted in from beyond the frontier. Its weight is comparable to that of an iron mass, requiring considerable strength, even for a revenant, to wield effectively.

Name: Argent Wolf Blade
Description:
A one-handed sword that requires Strength, Dexterity, and Willpower.

Its strong attack is an area-clearing sweep. Its charged strong attack consumes ichor to unleash a blood-element slash.

Midair strong attacks execute a falling thrust.

A sword that drifted in from beyond the frontier. Its imposing and ornate craftsmanship suggests that its wielders once held positions of power and influence.

Name: Flame Blade
Description:
A one-handed sword that primarily requires Dexterity and Willpower.

Attacks are imbued with the fire element.

Strong attacks deliver a downwards slash.
Charged strong attacks unleash a fiery slash. These slashes carry potent fire elemental effects.

Midair strong attacks consume ichor to unleash a fiery explosion.

This sword drifted in from beyond the frontier. Its origin is unclear, but it is believed to have been born under extremely unique circumstances, concealing powerful heat energy within.

Name: Iceblood
Description:
A one-handed sword that primarily requires Dexterity and Mind. 

Attacks are imbued with the ice element.

Strong attacks deliver a series of thrusts.
Charged strong attacks consume ichor to perform a thrust while unleashing ice.

A sword that drifted in from beyond the frontier, crafted with advanced technology to embed extreme cold within the blade. Its unnervingly meticulous design hints at the madness of its creator.

Name: Black Saber
Description:
A one-handed sword that primarily requires Strength. 

Weak attacks can be chained repeatedly as long as stamina allows.

Its strong attack is an area-clearing sweep. Its charged strong attack consumes ichor to unleash a blood-element slash.

Midair strong attacks perform a downward cut.

A sword that drifted in from outside the frontier. The jet-black blade carries the spirit of a hunter, one who has surely laid countless prey to rest.

Name: Sunset Sword
Description:
A one-handed sword that requires Strength and Dexterity.

Strong attacks are a diving slash, while charged strong attacks deliver two consecutive strikes after the dive.

This sword drifted in from beyond the frontier. Its blade has been altered by unknown elements.

Name: Lost Broadsword
Description:
A one-handed sword that requires Strength and Dexterity.

Moderately high bleed effect on hit.

Strong attacks deliver a sharp thrust.

Midair strong attacks perform a downward cut.

A sword that drifted in from beyond the frontier. Its blade is badly damaged and utterly neglected, as if its wielder had long since forsaken reason.

Name: VK Greatsword
Description:
A two-handed sword that primarily requires Strength.

Its balanced performance makes it easy to wield.

Strong attacks deliver a heavy slam while taking a forceful step forward.

A standard-issue two-handed sword used by revenant hunters. In the future, the blood that coats its blade will either be used to protect or to take. It all depends on the wielder.

Name: Ancient Hunter's Greatsword
Description:
A two-handed sword with minimal stat burden.

Strong attacks deliver a powerful thrust.

A two-handed sword once used by revenant hunters of a bygone era. Designed for ease of use, its excellent handling made it a trusted companion to many hunters on the battlefield.

Name: Cursed Backblade Killer
Description:
A two-handed sword that requires Strength and Dexterity.

Strong attacks unleash a two-hit combo following a forward lunge.

A two-handed sword imbued with a blood curse, based on a weapon crafted by a legendary revenant swordsmith. When wielded by a master of Far Eastern swordsmanship, its slash strikes with such precision it seems to drain every drop of the foe's blood.

Name: Dryad: Blade of the Forest Spirit
Description:
A two-handed sword that requires Strength and Willpower.

Strong attacks deliver a wide horizontal sweep attack.
Charged strong attacks consume ichor to unleash a lightning-element slash.

Discovered in the Undead Forest, this two-handed sword's origins remain unknown. Its blade is entwined with living wood, and ancient rites are etched into its surface—runes that pulse with energy and stir life in the creatures nearby.

Name: Iron Mass
Description:
A two-handed sword specialized for Strength.

Strong attacks deliver a heavy downward slam. Charged strong attacks hurl the wielder forward into a heavy slam.

This brutal weapon was forged by a pair of ancient revenant brothers renowned for their monstrous strength. Originally created to settle their own sibling disputes, it's nothing more than a massive hunk of metal with cloth wrapped around the grip, but its sheer weight makes every hit devastating.

Name: Primordial Greatsword
Description:
A two-handed sword that requires Strength, Dexterity, and Mind.

Strong attacks deliver a powerful thrust.

Forged in the age of the gods, this massive two-handed sword bears intricate runes inscribed with ancient formae. Only a chosen few are capable of mastering the patterns embedded within and wield it with true finesse.

Name: Glutton's Heavyblade
Description:
Josée's two-handed sword that requires Strength and Mind.

Attacks are imbued with the fire element.

Strong attacks unleash a two-hit combo following a forward lunge.

A two-handed sword custom-made by Josée for her own use. To compensate for the petite frame typical of the Gula Bloodline, she developed a unique fighting style that involves sweeping swings of an oversized blade empowered by formae. This weapon was tuned to endure the burden.

Name: Iron Mass of Dawn
Description:
Craig's two-handed sword that primarily requires Strength.

Strong attacks deliver a heavy downward slam. Charged strong attacks hurl the wielder forward into a heavy slam.

This is Craig's favored two-handed sword. On the day of his departure, he had nothing, only a chunk of metal used as a makeshift weapon. Through countless battles and trials, that crude slab of iron was forged into a blade of unbreakable conviction.

Name: Tainted Greatsword
Description:
A two-handed sword that requires Strength and Dexterity.

Strong attacks deliver a heavy slam while taking a forceful step forward.

Used by Voda soldiers, the sword's shape has become grotesquely warped from prolonged overexposure to ichor induced by the user's frenzy.

Name: Grotesque Skullblade
Description:
A two-handed sword that requires Strength and Dexterity.

Inflicts buildup of the venom status ailment.

Weak attacks can be chained repeatedly as long as stamina allows.

Strong attacks deliver a heavy downward slam. Charged strong attacks hurl the wielder forward into a heavy slam.

A two-handed sword twisted by the corruption of the Resurgence. Its grotesque blade slowly eats away at the sanity of those who dare wield it.

Name: Judgment Blade Gregory
Description:
A two-handed sword that requires Strength and Fortitude.

Strong attacks deliver a powerful thrust.

A two-handed sword wielded by the soldiers of McLeish House. Its blade, forged from a mesh of countless gears, tears through any obstacle in its path with brutal force.

Name: Cultist's Ritual Blade
Description:
A two-handed sword that requires Strength, Vitality, and Fortitude.

Strong attacks deliver a heavy slam while taking a forceful step forward.

A two-handed sword used in rituals by a revenant cult. The weapons they crafted for ceremonial use in their worship of the Resurgence emit an eerie presence.

Name: Ancient Retainer's Great Falchion
Description:
A two-handed sword that requires Strength and Dexterity.

Strong attacks deliver a heavy slam while taking a forceful step forward.

Wielded by the vassals of ancient revenants. These beings, created by the immensely powerful Progenitors, have endured through the ages, never perishing. Even in their skeletal, golden remains, they continue to brandish these gifted weapons in honor of their masters' eternal glory.

Name: Resurgence Flame Greatsword
Description:
A two-handed sword that requires Strength, Dexterity, and Willpower.

Weak attacks can be chained repeatedly as long as stamina allows.

Charged strong attacks consume ichor to unleash a lightning-element slash.

This two-handed sword wielded by revenants born within Luna Rapacis. They took on a humanoid form as a result of convergent evolution triggered by the Resurgence, but genealogically are anything but human. The weapons they wield blaze with the warped flames of that transformation.

Name: Idris's Talon
Description:
A two-handed sword specialized for Strength.

Strong attacks deliver a heavy downward slam. Charged strong attacks hurl the wielder forward into a heavy slam.

A two-handed sword bestowed upon the retainers of Idris. To stand against the threats looming over the world, the first thing Progenitor Idris sought was strength in its purest form.

Name: Nameless Greatsword
Description:
A two-handed sword that primarily requires Strength.

Strong attacks deliver a heavy slam while taking a forceful step forward.

This two-handed sword drifted in from beyond the frontier. Its origin is unclear, but the discovery of many identical weapons suggests it was mass-produced—likely in response to a significant threat.

Description:
A two-handed sword with low stat burden and high offensive power.

Strong attacks unleash a two-hit combo following a forward lunge.

Crafted with a unique design philosophy, this two-handed sword is forged from materials with an extremely low burden, making it accessible to nearly any wielder. The faded engravings etched into its frame carry a quiet, sorrowful emotion.

Name: Zweihander
Description:
A two-handed sword that requires Strength and Vitality.

Weak attacks can be chained repeatedly as long as stamina allows.

Strong attacks deliver a powerful thrust.

This two-handed sword drifted in from beyond the frontier. Its mass-produced design is apparent, but its hefty weight suggests it was made for wielders with exceptional physiques.

Name: Nagimukuro
Description:
A two-handed sword that requires Strength and Dexterity.

Strong attacks unleash a two-hit combo following a forward lunge.

This two-handed sword drifted in from beyond the frontier, bearing the name "Mukuro." Its massive blade resembles those forged using techniques practiced in the Far East.

Name: Warped Blade
Description:
A two-handed sword that requires Strength and Fortitude.

Strong attacks deliver a wide horizontal sweep attack.
Charged strong attacks consume ichor to unleash a blood-element slash.

This two-handed sword drifted in from beyond the frontier. Its sharp, saw-like edge is as brutal as its nature—draining its wielder's blood and transmuting it into raw destructive power.

Name: Black Greatsword
Description:
A two-handed sword that requires Strength and Willpower.

Strong attacks deliver a powerful blow while stepping forward.
Charged strong attacks consume ichor to unleash a blood-element slash.

This two-handed sword drifted in from beyond the frontier. Its ominous blade bears the lingering madness of those who once wielded it.

Name: Argent Wolf King's Blade
Description:
A two-handed sword that requires Strength and Mind.

Strong attacks deliver a powerful blow while stepping forward.
Charged strong attacks consume ichor to unleash a blood-element slash.

This two-handed sword drifted in from beyond the frontier. It features a grotesque and unusual mechanism, one that directly channels copious amounts of blood into the weapon itself.

Name: Sunset Greatsword
Description:
A two-handed sword that requires Strength and Dexterity.

Strong attacks deliver a heavy slam while taking a forceful step forward.

This two-handed sword drifted in from beyond the frontier. Its blade has been altered by unknown elements.

Name: Lost Zweihander
Description:
A two-handed sword that primarily requires Strength.

Moderately high bleed effect on hit.

Strong attacks deliver a powerful thrust.

This two-handed sword drifted in from beyond the frontier. Its blade is badly damaged and utterly neglected, as if its wielder had long since forsaken reason.

Name: VK Dual Blades
Description:
Twin blades that primarily require Dexterity.

Strong attacks unleash a forward-spinning slash.

Midair weak attacks can combo into a midair strong attack.

Midair strong attacks perform a spinning downward slash.

Standard-issue twin blades used by revenant hunters. In the future, the blood that coats its blade will either be used to protect or to take. It all depends on the wielder.

Name: Ancient Hunter's Twin Blades
Description:
Twin blades with reduced stat burden.

Strong attacks cause the wielder to lunge forward a short distance, slashing in a cross pattern with both blades.

Midair strong attacks perform a twin-blade dive thrust.

Twin blades once used by revenant hunters of a bygone era. Designed for ease of use, its excellent handling made it a trusted companion to many hunters on the battlefield.

Name: Twin Fangs of the Lone Wolf
Description:
Twin blades that require Mind and Willpower.

Strong attacks unleash a forward-spinning slash.

Midair strong attacks perform a spinning downward slash.

Twin blades engraved with a special forma. Their edges bite into prey like the jaws of a wolf, proving the resolve of the hunter who wields them.

Name: Fangs of the Hunter
Description:
Twin blades specialized for Dexterity.

Strong attacks thrust forward with both blades in unison.

Midair weak attacks can combo into a midair strong attack.

Midair strong attacks perform a twin-blade dive thrust.

Forged by a revenant with the rare past of being a former revenant hunter. Though fate twisted him into the very thing he once hunted, he continued to honor the old ways, wielding weapons shaped like stakes, crafted to pierce the hearts of his former prey.

Name: Twinfang Blades
Description:
Twin blades that require Dexterity and Willpower.

Strong attacks consume ichor to deliver an attack while spawning thorns of ice.
Charged strong attacks unleash a fire-element slash.

Midair weak attacks can combo into a midair strong attack.

Midair strong attacks perform a spinning downward slash.

Forged by a powerful pair of twin revenants, these blades reflect their unique bond, each able to regulate the other's formae. The weapons are said to wield both flame and frost, shifting seamlessly between opposing forces.

Name: Jade Curved Blades
Description:
Twin blades that require Strength and Dexterity.

Strong attacks unleash a fluid series of slashes with both blades.

Midair strong attacks perform a spinning downward slash.

These twin curved swords once belonged to a revenant famed across the Middle East and Asia. Their form suits the local fighting styles, enabling graceful, dance-like movements that slice through foes.

Name: Swift Thunder
Description:
Twin blades that primarily require Dexterity.

Charged strong attacks cause the wielder to lunge forward a short distance, slashing in a cross pattern with electrified blades. These slashes carry potent lightning elemental effects.

Midair weak attacks can combo into a midair strong attack.

Midair strong attacks perform a twin-blade dive thrust.

These twin blades belonged to the hero Lyle. Though drastically altered by the Resurgence's energy, the thunderous power inherited in his blood remained unchanged. A steadfast embodiment of his will.

Name: Fangs of Conviction
Description:
Noah's twin blades that require Dexterity and Vitality.

Strong attacks thrust forward with both blades in unison.

Midair weak attacks can combo into a midair strong attack.

Midair strong attacks perform a spinning downward slash.

Forged by Noah's own hands, these blades embody his unshaken resolve. In his quest for the strength to protect his family, he embraced becoming a revenant and sought his place within that world. What emerged was a power born not of domination, but of harmony.

Name: Glutton's Bells
Description:
Twin blades that require Strength and Mind.

Strong attacks unleash a fluid series of dual slashes.

Midair weak attacks can combo into a midair strong attack.

Midair strong attacks perform a spinning downward slash.

These twin blades belonged to the hero Josée. When absorbing the energy of the Resurgence, the power of the Gula Bloodline helped suppress the transformation, allowing her core nature to remain intact. This weapon is a manifestation of her wish for a peaceful future.

Name: Blazing Talons
Description:
Twin blades that require Dexterity and Willpower.

Strong attacks cause the wielder to lunge forward a short distance, slashing in a cross pattern with both blades.

Midair weak attacks can combo into a midair strong attack.

Midair strong attacks perform a spinning downward slash.

These twin blades drifted in from beyond the frontier. Shaped like the claws of a beast, the blades radiate intense heat. Given their feral design and raw power, it's clear they were never meant to be wielded by one bound to human form.

Name: Twin Blades of Hunger
Description:
Twin blades that primarily require Strength.

Strong attacks unleash a forward-spinning slash.

Midair weak attacks can combo into a midair strong attack.

Midair strong attacks perform a twin-blade dive thrust.

These twin blades drifted in from beyond the frontier. When combined, they form a single weapon. Apart, they serve as deadly paired swords.

Name: VK Rifle
Description:
A bayonet that primarily requires Dexterity.

Its balanced performance makes it easy to wield.

Features a rifle firing mechanism. Strong attacks consume rifle ammo to fire mid-range rounds.

Press and hold strong attack to reload manually.

A standard-issue bayonet used by revenant hunters. In the future, the blood that coats its blade will either be used to protect or to take. It all depends on the wielder.

Name: Ancient Hunter's Bayonet
Description:
A bayonet with reduced stat burden.

Features a rifle firing mechanism. Strong attacks consume rifle ammo to fire mid-range projectiles.

Press and hold strong attack to reload manually.

A bayonet once used by revenant hunters of a bygone era. Designed for ease of use, its excellent handling made it a trusted companion to many hunters on the battlefield.

Name: Silver Shot
Description:
A bayonet that primarily requires Strength and Dexterity.

Features a shotgun firing mechanism. Strong attacks consume shotgun ammo to fire short-range scattershots.

Scattershot damage increases the closer the target is.

Press and hold strong attack to reload manually.

A bayonet designed to fire shotgun shells. Its large blade reflects its intended use in frequent close-quarters combat.

Name: Grenade Launcher
Description:
A bayonet that requires Strength and Dexterity.

Features a grenade firing mechanism. Strong attacks consume grenade ammo to launch explosive mid-range shells.

Press and hold strong attack to reload manually.

A bayonet designed to fire grenade-type rounds. Its compact blade reflects a focus on firing precision over close-quarters power.

Name: Alfheim
Description:
A bayonet that requires Dexterity and Willpower.

Features a forma-rifle firing mechanism. Strong attacks consume rifle ammo to fire long-range light projectiles imbued with ice.

Press and hold strong attack to reload manually.

A bayonet governed by formae. By processing loaded rounds through forma manipulation, it unleashes enhanced destructive power.

Name: Raider's Bayonet
Description:
A bayonet that requires Dexterity and Willpower.

Features a forma-rifle firing mechanism. Strong attacks consume rifle ammo to fire long-range magic rounds with high homing capability.

Press and hold strong attack to reload manually.

This was the bayonet once used by Frantz. A master of manipulating matter through formae, he applied this technique to bullets, culminating in the creation of homing magic rounds.

Name: Snowdrop
Description:
Holly's bayonet that requires Dexterity and Willpower.

Features a forma-rifle firing mechanism. Strong attacks consume rifle ammo to fire long-range light projectiles imbued with ice.

Press and hold strong attack to reload manually.

Holly's personal bayonet. While the technique of using formae to imbue bullets with effects is widely known, Holly developed this forma from scratch to craft a weapon entirely her own.

This bayonet drifted in from beyond the frontier. Its lustrous barrel and steel blade make it a striking weapon, worthy of the crimson gem it is named after.

Description:
A bayonet that requires Dexterity and Mind.

Features a rifle firing mechanism. Strong attacks consume rifle ammo to fire mid-range projectiles.

Press and hold strong attack to reload manually.

This bayonet drifted in from beyond the frontier. Its imposing and ornate craftsmanship suggests that its wielder once held positions of power and influence.

Name: Burning Disaster
Description:
A bayonet that requires Strength and Mind.

Features a grenade firing mechanism. Strong attacks consume grenade ammo to launch mid-range explosive fireballs.

The forma inscribed on the weapon greatly enhances its fire-elemental potency.

Press and hold strong attack to reload manually.

This bayonet drifted in from beyond the frontier. Capable of unleashing searing flames at will, its cruel design offers a glimpse into the madness of its maker.

Name: Sunset Bayonet
Description:
A bayonet that requires Dexterity and Willpower.

Features a rifle firing mechanism. Strong attacks consume rifle ammo to fire mid-range projectiles.

Press and hold strong attack to reload manually.

This bayonet drifted in from beyond the frontier. Its blade has been altered by unknown elements.

Name: Black Bayonet
Description:
A bayonet specialized for Dexterity.

Features a rifle firing mechanism. Strong attacks consume rifle ammo to fire mid-range projectiles.

Press and hold strong attack to reload manually.

This bayonet drifted in from beyond the frontier. Its ominous blade bears the lingering madness of those who once wielded it.

Name: Lost Bayonet
Description:
A bayonet that primarily requires Dexterity.

Moderately high bleed effect on hit.

Features a shotgun firing mechanism. Strong attacks consume shotgun ammo to unleash short-range scattershots.

Scattershot damage increases the closer the target is.

Press and hold strong attack to reload manually.

This bayonet drifted in from beyond the frontier. Its blade is badly damaged and utterly neglected, as if its wielder had long since forsaken reason.

Name: VK Halberd
Description:
A halberd that requires Strength and Dexterity.

Its balanced performance makes it easy to wield.

Strong attacks unleash a far-reaching downward slash.

A standard-issue halberd used by revenant hunters. In the future, the blood that coats its blade will either be used to protect or to take. It all depends on the wielder.

Name: Ancient Hunter's Halberd
Description:
A halberd with reduced stat burden.

Strong attacks unleash a two-hit combo of a lunging thrust followed by a sweeping slash.

A halberd once used by revenant hunters of a bygone era. Designed for ease of use, its excellent handling made it a trusted companion to many hunters on the battlefield.

Name: Pelagic Spear
Description:
A halberd that primarily requires Strength and Dexterity.

Strong attacks execute a two-hit combo after a stepping lunge.

A halberd renowned in the Asian region, wielded by a revenant who was also an exceptional fisherman. This revenant was said to have perfected the art of the precise thrust, capable of striking down any prey with unmatched accuracy.

Name: Pisar's Venom Pike
Description:
A halberd that requires Strength and Dexterity.

Inflicts buildup of the venom status ailment.

Strong attacks execute a backstep followed by a lunging sweep.

This halberd once belonged to the legendary revenant Pisar, said to wield flames of poison that consumed all they touched. Even without its master, the weapon still flickers with his lingering pathos.

Name: Solomonal Halberd
Description:
A halberd that primarily requires Willpower.

Strong attacks deliver a spinning upward slash.
Charged strong attacks consume ichor to unleash a blood-element slash.

This halberd was forged by a revenant said to have graduated from a school once rumored to be run by demons. Though imperfect, it bears an inscription of a forma capable of influencing the weather itself.

Name: Solar Halberd: Zenon
Description:
Zenon's halberd that requires Strength and Dexterity.

Inflicts buildup of the sunblight status ailment.

Strong attacks deliver a spinning upward slash. Charged strong attacks consume ichor to unleash a blood-element slash.

Modeled after the Solomonal Halberd, this weapon was crafted by Zenon himself. By adapting the weather-altering forma and combining it with another forma he once devised to overcome the sun, he forged a halberd capable of inflicting the terror of sunlight upon his foes.

Name: Iron Mass: Heavy Halberd
Description:
A halberd that primarily requires Strength.

Strong attacks unleash a far-reaching downward slash.

This brutal weapon was forged by a pair of ancient revenant brothers renowned for their monstrous strength. Originally created to settle their own sibling disputes, it's nothing more than a massive hunk of metal with cloth wrapped around the grip, but its sheer weight makes every hit devastating.

Name: Tainted Halberd
Description:
A halberd that requires Strength and Dexterity.

Strong attacks unleash a far-reaching downward slash.

Used by Voda soldiers, the halberd's shape has become grotesquely warped from prolonged overexposure to ichor induced by the user's frenzy.

Name: Judgment Halberd Gregory
Description:
A halberd that requires Strength and Dexterity.

Strong attacks execute a two-hit combo after a stepping lunge.

A halberd wielded by the soldiers of McLeish House. Its blade, forged from a mesh of countless gears, tears through any obstacle in its path with brutal force.

Name: Cultist's Ceremonial Halberd
Description:
A halberd that requires Strength, Dexterity, Vitality, and Fortitude.

Strong attacks unleash a two-hit combo of a lunging thrust followed by a sweeping slash.

A halberd used in rituals by a revenant cult. The weapons they crafted for ceremonial use in their worship of the Resurgence emit an eerie presence.

Name: Ancient Retainer's Ring Spear
Description:
A halberd that requires Strength and Dexterity.

Moderately high bleed effect on hit.

Strong attacks execute a backstep followed by a lunging sweep.

Wielded by the vassals of ancient revenants. These beings, created by the immensely powerful Progenitors, have endured through the ages, never perishing. Even in their skeletal, golden remains, they continue to brandish these gifted weapons in honor of their masters' eternal glory.

Name: Resurgence Flame Halberd
Description:
A halberd that requires Strength, Dexterity, and Willpower.

Strong attacks deliver a spinning upward slash.
Charged strong attacks consume ichor to unleash a blood-element slash.

A halberd wielded by revenants born within Luna Rapacis. They took on a humanoid form as a result of convergent evolution triggered by the Resurgence, but genealogically are anything but human. The weapons they wield blaze with the warped flames of that transformation.

Name: Lance of the Moon King
Description:
A halberd that requires Strength, Dexterity, Mind, and Willpower.

Possesses enormous forma capacity.

Strong attacks unleash a two-hit combo of a lunging thrust followed by a sweeping slash.

This halberd belonged to the king who lingered within the moon, yearning endlessly for the future. With it, he sought to bring his dreams to life—to fulfill the hopes of those who believed in him, the wishes of friends who stood by him. Yet the heart of this king, who strove to realize every ideal, was hollow and missing something vital.

Name: Moon Envoy's Staff
Description:
A halberd specialized for Strength.

Strong attacks unleash a far-reaching downward slash.

Brandished by the envoys of the moon, this halberd has taken on an eerie, staff-like form. Curiously, its warped blade bears a strong resemblance to the flora twisted by the Resurgence.

Name: Halberd of the Minion: Praise
Description:
A halberd that primarily requires Strength and Dexterity.

Strong attacks unleash a two-hit combo of a lunging thrust followed by a sweeping slash.

A halberd Zenon gave to his own surrogate. It possesses performance on par with the original, but the forma control functions have been omitted.

Name: Pioneer Queen's Glaive
Description:
A halberd that requires Strength, Dexterity, and Willpower.

Strong attacks unleash a far-reaching downward slash.

This halberd belonged to Pioneer Queen Imogen. Its blade, forged from a mass of interlocking gears, tears through all who stand in its path with brutal force. This mechanical design has since become a signature trait of her bloodline.

Name: Nameless Halberd
Description:
A halberd that requires Strength and Dexterity.

Strong attacks unleash a far-reaching downward slash.

This halberd drifted in from beyond the frontier. Its origin is unclear, but the discovery of many identical weapons suggests it was mass-produced—likely in response to a significant threat.

Name: Bardiche
Description:
A halberd that requires Strength and Dexterity.

Strong attacks execute a backstep followed by a lunging sweep.

This halberd drifted in from beyond the frontier. Its mass-produced design is apparent, but its hefty weight suggests it was made for wielders with exceptional physiques.

Name: Impaler
Description:
A halberd that primarily requires Dexterity.

Strong attacks execute a two-hit combo after a stepping lunge.

This halberd drifted in from beyond the frontier. Despite its light weight, it boasts excellent cutting and piercing power. With enough training, it allows for adaptable combat, capable of overwhelming any foe.

Name: Garnet Splitter
Description:
A halberd that requires Strength, Dexterity, and Mind.

Its strong attack is a rising spin attack. Its charged strong attack consumes ichor to unleash a blood-element slash.

This halberd drifted in from beyond the frontier. Despite its massive, sharp blade, those who wield it report an uncanny sense of calm, as if the weapon itself tempers the passions of the soul.

Name: Black Halberd
Description:
A halberd that requires Strength, Dexterity, and Mind.

Strong attacks unleash a two-hit combo of a lunging thrust followed by a sweeping slash.

This halberd drifted in from beyond the frontier. Its ominous blade bears the lingering madness of those who once wielded it.

Name: Assassin's Sickle
Description:
A halberd that requires Dexterity and Willpower.

Strong attacks execute a backstep followed by a lunging sweep.
Charged strong attacks build up the stall status ailment.

This halberd drifted in from beyond the frontier. Those who touch it describe a creeping chill, as though sinking into the depths of a black abyss, consumed by cold malice.

Name: Sunset Halberd
Description:
A halberd that requires Strength and Dexterity.

Moderately high bleed effect on hit.

Strong attacks unleash a far-reaching downward slash.

This halberd drifted in from beyond the frontier. Its blade has been altered by unknown elements.

Name: Lost Bardiche
Description:
A halberd that primarily requires Dexterity.

Strong attacks execute a backstep followed by a lunging sweep.

This halberd drifted in from beyond the frontier. Its blade is badly damaged and utterly neglected, as if its wielder had long since forsaken reason.

Name: Obliterator Axe
Description:
A halberd specialized for Strength.

Strong attacks unleash a far-reaching downward slash.

This halberd drifted in from beyond the frontier. Exceptionally heavy, it demands immense physical power to wield. Throughout history, only a rare few are thought to have ever mastered it.

Name: Argent Wolf Poleaxe
Description:
A halberd that primarily requires Dexterity.

Strong attacks execute a two-hit combo after a stepping lunge.

This halberd drifted in from beyond the frontier. Its imposing and ornate craftsmanship suggests that its wielder once held positions of power and influence.

Name: VK Hammer
Description:
A hammer that primarily requires Strength.

Its balanced performance makes it easy to wield.

Strong attacks deliver a full-force strike.

A standard-issue hammer used by revenant hunters. In the future, the blood that coats its blade will either be used to protect or to take. It all depends on the wielder.

Name: Ancient Hunter's Hammer
Description:
A hammer with reduced stat burden.

Strong attacks swing the hammer in a full arc, raising it high.

A hammer once used by revenant hunters of a bygone era. Designed for ease of use, its excellent handling made it a trusted companion to many hunters on the battlefield.

Name: Forma Mech-Hammer Mjolnir
Description:
A hammer that requires Strength and Dexterity.

Equipped with a propulsion mechanism, it allows for movement-based attacks.

Strong attacks are a rotating strike following a charge. Charged strong attacks start with a rotating strike, followed by an upper swing that launches the user into the air. After jumping, midair attacks are possible.

A hammer loaded with formaeology technology. The propulsion mechanism enables rapid acceleration, allowing the user to soar across the battlefield in all directions. The strike, powered by this momentum, can shatter any enemy.

Name: Caged Heart Club
Description:
A hammer that requires Strength and Mind.

Moderately high bleed effect on hit.

Strong attacks deliver a short-reaching slam. Charged strong attacks consume ichor to unleash a blood-element shock wave.

A hammer incorporating the function of a prison. Originally intended to display the hearts of imprisoned revenants as a warning, some of the hearts emitted formae deemed useful, and as a result, a few criminals were destined to meet their end as weapons.

Name: Primordial Battle Axe
Description:
A hammer that primarily requires Strength.

Strong attacks execute a short leap lunge followed by a heavy horizontal slash.

Forged in the age of the gods, this massive hammer bears intricate runes inscribed with ancient formae. Only a chosen few are capable of mastering the patterns embedded within and wield it with true finesse.

Name: Forma Mech-Hammer Goliath
Description:
A hammer specialized for Strength.

Strong attacks execute a short step followed by a sweeping horizontal strike. Charged strong attacks perform a spinning attack like a top.

A hammer made from parts of the forma war machine Goliath. Goliath, a bio-weapon, grows over time. As it gradually grew larger, parts that no longer fit its specifications were repurposed into this hammer.

Name: Pain Carrier
Description:
Iris's hammer that primarily requires Strength.

Equipped with a propulsion mechanism, it allows for movement-based attacks.

Strong attacks perform a rotating strike after rushing forward. Charged strong attacks start with a rotating strike, followed by an upper swing that launches the user into the air, allowing for midair attacks after the motion.

A hammer modified personally by Iris. She adjusted the pre-installed propulsion mechanism, adding booster technology to achieve a higher output and significantly increase its power.

Name: Tainted Hammer
Description:
A hammer that primarily requires Strength.

Strong attacks deliver a full-force strike.

Used by Voda soldiers, the hammer's shape has become grotesquely warped from prolonged overexposure to ichor induced by the user's frenzy.

Name: Grotesque Bone Mace
Description:
A hammer that primarily requires Strength.

Inflicts buildup of the venom status ailment.

Strong attacks execute a short step followed by a sweeping horizontal strike. Charged strong attacks perform a spinning attack like a top.

A hammer twisted by the corruption of the Resurgence. The grotesque head slowly eats away at the sanity of those who dare wield it.

Name: Resurgence Flame Hammer
Description:
A hammer that requires Strength and Willpower.

Strong attacks deliver a short-range smash. Charged strong attacks consume ichor to unleash a blood-element shock wave.

A hammer wielded by revenants born within Luna Rapacis. They took on a humanoid form as a result of convergent evolution triggered by the Resurgence, but genealogically are anything but human. The weapons they wield blaze with the warped flames of that transformation.

Name: Hammer of Thralldom
Description:
A hammer that is rather unreliable as a weapon.

Strong attacks deliver a full-force strike.

It is simply a concrete block with a handle attached, making it unreliable as a weapon for ordinary people. However, it is also said that a master does not choose their weapon.

Name: Nameless Hammer
Description:
A hammer that primarily requires Strength.

Strong attacks deliver a full-force strike.

This hammer drifted in from beyond the frontier. Its origin is unclear, but the discovery of many identical weapons suggests it was mass-produced—likely in response to a significant threat.

Name: Old Engraved Hammer
Description:
A hammer with low stat burden and high offensive power.

Strong attacks execute a short leap lunge followed by a heavy horizontal slash.

Crafted with a unique design philosophy, this hammer is forged from materials with an extremely low burden, making it accessible to nearly any wielder. The faded engravings etched into its frame carry a quiet, sorrowful emotion.

Name: Heavy Axe
Description:
A hammer that primarily requires Strength.

Strong attacks execute a short leap lunge followed by a heavy horizontal slash.

This hammer drifted in from beyond the frontier. Its mass-produced design is apparent, but its hefty weight suggests it was made for wielders with exceptional physiques.

Name: Impulse Anchor
Description:
A hammer that primarily requires Strength.

Moderately high bleed effect on hit.

Equipped with a propulsion mechanism, it allows for movement-based attacks.

Strong attacks are a rotating strike following a charge. Charged strong attacks start with a rotating strike, followed by an upper swing that launches the user into the air, allowing for midair attacks after the motion.

This hammer drifted in from beyond the frontier. Equipped with a propulsion mechanism whose technology seems to be a product of peculiar methods.

Name: Huge Hammer
Description:
A hammer specialized for Strength.

Strong attacks execute a short step followed by a sweeping horizontal strike. Charged strong attacks perform a spinning attack like a top.

This hammer drifted in from beyond the frontier. The entire weapon has been transformed into a monstrous shape due to unknown elements, making it impossible to discern its original form.

Name: Argent Wolf Warhammer
Description:
A hammer that requires Strength and Dexterity.

Strong attacks execute a short leap lunge followed by a heavy horizontal slash.

This hammer drifted in from beyond the frontier. Its imposing and ornate craftsmanship suggests that its wielder once held positions of power and influence.

Name: Tyrant's Labrys
Description:
A hammer specialized for Strength.

Strong attacks deliver a short-reaching slam. Charged strong attacks consume ichor to unleash a blood-element shock wave.

This hammer drifted in from beyond the frontier. Those who touch it feel their minds being corroded, gaining a violent ferocity akin to that of a tyrant.

Name: Sunset Hammer
Description:
A hammer that primarily requires Strength.

Strong attacks deliver a full-force strike.

This hammer drifted in from beyond the frontier. Its blade has been altered by unknown elements.

Name: Lost Heavy Axe
Description:
A hammer that requires Strength and Dexterity.

Moderately high bleed effect on hit.

Strong attacks execute a short leap lunge followed by a heavy horizontal slash.

This hammer drifted in from beyond the frontier. Its blade is badly damaged and utterly neglected, as if its wielder had long since forsaken reason.

Name: VK Rune Blades
Description:
Rune blades that primarily require Willpower.

Their balanced performance makes them easy to wield.

Strong attacks swing the blades in a wide arc along with a spinning kick.

Midair weak attacks can combo into a midair strong attack.

Midair strong attacks sharply descend while delivering a kick.

Standard-issue dual floating swords used by revenant hunters. In the future, the blood that coats the blades will either be used to protect or to take. It all depends on the wielder.

Name: Ancient Hunter's Rune Blades
Description:
Rune blades with reduced stat burden.

Strong attacks deliver a blade strike accompanied by a heel drop.

Midair weak attacks can combo into a midair strong attack.

Midair strong attacks make the player hang in air while the blades cross at high speed.

Dual floating swords once used by revenant hunters of a bygone era. Designed for ease of use, their excellent handling made them a trusted companion to many hunters on the battlefield.

Name: Bloodrune
Description:
Rune blades that require Mind and Willpower.

Strong attacks deliver a long-range jumping kick.

Midair weak attacks can combo into a midair strong attack.

Midair strong attacks sharply descend while delivering a kick.

Dual floating swords designed with Valentin's involvement. Designed as a weapon befitting the revenant species that rules the world, they embody nobility, strength, and most importantly, a reminder to never forget the love directed toward others. They were created with the desire to preserve those values.

Name: Glutton's Eyes
Description:
Rune blades that primarily require Mind.

Strong attacks deliver a guillotine attack with the blades. Charged strong attacks consume ichor to unleash a fire-element slash.

Midair weak attacks can combo into a midair strong attack.

Midair strong attacks hover while crossing the blades at high speed.

Dual floating swords created by Josée after gaining control over her own power. The force that once sought to consume everything around her now bows under the weight of nobility and kindness, reborn as blades that protect the ones she cherishes.

Name: Glutton's Eyes EX
Description:
Lise's rune blades that require Dexterity and Mind.

Strong attacks deliver a guillotine attack with the blades. Charged strong attacks consume ichor to unleash a fire-element slash.

Midair weak attacks can combo into a midair strong attack.

Midair strong attacks hover while crossing the blades at high speed.

Floating swords created by Lise herself. Though the process was different, Lise, having suppressed the power of the Gula Bloodline, created these swords under the same unwavering will as her older sister with the sole wish to have the strength to protect her family. Its blades are a mirror image of the swords created by her sister.

Name: Stealth Blades
Description:
Rune blades specialized for Willpower.

Strong attacks deliver a spinning kick while slashing the surrounding area with the blades.

Midair weak attacks can combo into a midair strong attack.

Midair strong attacks hover while crossing the blades at high speed.

Dual floating swords wielded by the assassins of the Bureau. Although controlling a floating sword usually requires great focus and training, the revenants of the Bureau forcefully expand their consciousness through the use of drugs, enabling them to control multiple floating swords at once.

Name: Formae Mech-Arms Tajikarao
Description:
Rune blades that require Strength and Willpower.

Strong attacks charge forward to deliver a body slam.

Midair weak attacks can combo into a midair strong attack.

Midair strong attacks sharply descend while delivering a kick.

Dual floating swords crafted using formaeology technology. They are no longer just swords, but the very arms of a giant beast, and their immense mass allows for a powerful, straightforward breakthrough, as its appearance suggests.

Name: Formae Mech-Arms Lycoris
Description:
Monica's rune blades that primarily require Willpower.

Strong attacks charge forward to deliver a body slam.

Midair weak attacks can combo into a midair strong attack.

Midair strong attacks sharply descend while delivering a kick.

Dual floating swords with the appearance of arms transferred by Lycoris from somewhere. Possibly due to her deep knowledge of formaeology, Lycoris wields these floating swords with ease, as though they were an extension of her own limbs, despite its difficulty to control.

Name: Blades of Noble Blood
Description:
Valentin's rune blades that require Strength, Dexterity, and Willpower.

Strong attacks deliver a long-range jumping kick.

Midair weak attacks can combo into a midair strong attack.

Midair strong attacks sharply descend while delivering a kick.

Dual floating swords created personally by Valentin. An enhanced version of the Bloodrune, with exclusive modifications made to suit his design. The will to be worthy of wielding these swords is expressed more strongly than ever.

Name: Crimson Floating Swords
Description:
Rune blades that require Dexterity and Willpower.

Weak attacks can be chained repeatedly as long as stamina allows.

Strong attacks deliver an upward swipe while also slashing the blades up.
Charged strong attacks consume ichor to unleash a fire-element slash.

Midair weak attacks can combo into a midair strong attack.

Midair strong attacks hover while crossing the blades at high speed.

Dual floating swords processed using formae. The blades are enveloped in heat energy so intense that they glow red, boasting extraordinary cutting power.
